text: {"question":"If the blue edge of the selection box is tightened to (J−Ks)₀=1.5 mag and the DES supernova sample is further restricted to |cSALT|<0.15, what are the resulting contamination fraction for the stellar sample and the H₀ value derived from the Hubble‑flow supernovae?","reference_answer":"The tightened blue edge yields a contamination of about 52 % for the stellar sample, while the |cSALT|<0.15 restriction gives an H₀ of roughly 73.34 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹."}
